description: This file defines the interface class IOmiProxy in the omi namespace. The IOmiProxy class provides methods for mounting and unmounting encrypted bundles, as well as registering and unregistering error listeners. It is intended as a wrapper around an omi_dbus_api for simplifying method calls and signal registration.

classes.name: IOmiProxy
classes.description: An interface class that provides methods for managing encrypted bundles and error listeners, intended to wrap omi_dbus_api functionalities.

methods.name: mountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Mounts an encrypted bundle given its container ID, filesystem image path, and configuration JSON path. Outputs the path to the decrypted config JSON. Returns true if successful.

methods.name: umountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Unmounts a crypted bundle specified by its container ID. Returns true if successful.

methods.name: registerListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for error events, returning a listener ID or 0 on failure.

methods.name: unregisterListener
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered listener given its tag ID.

ctags.name: OmiErrorListener
ctags.pattern: /^    typedef std::function<void(const std::string&, ErrorType, const void*)> OmiErrorListener;$/
